sources.text:
Checkout retries are scoped by tenant and idempotency key. Reusing a key with a
different payload is rejected before inventory or payment state changes.

The admin application renders a tenant-scoped order operations dashboard from
the checkout read model. SQL migrations document the persisted order and
idempotency constraints used by the same flow.

CREATE TABLE orders (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  customer_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  sku TEXT NOT NULL,
  quantity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (quantity > 0),
  total_cents INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (total_cents >= 0),
  payment_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  reservation_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  event_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('paid', 'cancelled')),
  placed_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX orders_tenant_placed_at ON orders (tenant_id, placed_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE idempotency_records (
  tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  request_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
  result_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  recorded_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, idempotency_key)
);

labels.reason: apps/api/src/checkout-handler.ts imports requireIdempotencyKey, implemented by apps/api/src/idempotency-header.ts.
CheckoutHandler's new requireIdempotencyKey import supplies the function called before checkout.place.
CheckoutHandler.handle adds headers and excludes body idempotencyKey; its body reads those headers and passes the resulting key to checkout.place.

apps/api/src/checkout-handler.ts adapts HTTP headers and the authenticated tenant into a checkout request; packages/checkout/src/checkout-service.ts defines the optional domain input field. The API adapter and checkout contract are separate review responsibilities despite their interface dependency.
apps/api/src/index.ts exports the new idempotency-header module and its requireIdempotencyKey validation.
CheckoutService's new input.idempotencyKey field controls tenant/key lookup, fingerprint conflict detection, and replay.
checkout-service.ts imports requestFingerprint and IdempotencyConflict used by the new replay/conflict branch, alongside its repository types.
CheckoutService's new idempotency and attempts constructor members are used for lookup and attempt creation in place.
CheckoutService compares existing.requestFingerprint with requestFingerprint(input), whose payload fields are defined in checkout-request.ts.
CheckoutService throws the new IdempotencyConflict when a stored key's request fingerprint differs.
CheckoutService uses IdempotencyRepository.find(input.tenantId, input.idempotencyKey) to retrieve the result to replay.
checkout-service.ts must use matching tenant/key and fingerprint semantics when finding earlier results and saving successful results for later replay.
IdempotencyRepository stores IdempotencyRecord values containing tenantId, key, requestFingerprint, result, and recordedAt.
CheckoutService constructs the IdempotencyRecord shape, including its PlaceOrderResult and recordedAt, when saving a successful checkout.
CheckoutAttemptRepository.start, finish, and all operate on CheckoutAttempt and its started/rejected/completed state contract.
CheckoutService creates attemptId and calls CheckoutAttemptRepository.start; subsequent finish calls depend on that stored attempt.
checkout-service.ts starts an attempt in hunk 3 and finishes that same attemptId as rejected on insufficient stock in hunk 4.
checkout-service.ts starts attemptId in hunk 3 and records payment rejection with charge.reason in hunk 5.

packages/checkout/src/checkout-request.ts owns the retryable request contract and fingerprint calculation; RetryCheckoutWorker.run only forwards a request to CheckoutService.place. Worker integration can be reviewed separately from domain retry semantics.
apps/worker/src/index.ts exports the newly added RetryCheckoutWorker module.
packages/checkout/src/index.ts exports checkout-request, making RetryableCheckoutRequest available through the checkout package API.
packages/checkout/src/index.ts adds the public checkout-attempt-repository export alongside its CheckoutAttempt model.
packages/checkout/src/index.ts exports the new idempotency repository and record modules as part of the retry API.
packages/checkout/src/index.ts exposes IdempotencyConflict through its new idempotency-conflict export.
packages/checkout/src/system.ts imports CheckoutAttemptRepository and IdempotencyRepository and then instantiates both.
system.ts creates the idempotency and attempts repositories required by CheckoutService's two new constructor parameters.
apps/admin/src/page-shell.ts links /admin.css; apps/admin/admin.css supplies the new page's layout and styling.
renderStatusBadge emits status and status--paid/status--cancelled classes styled by apps/admin/admin.css.
apps/admin/package.json identifies the new private admin package, while apps/admin/tsconfig.json defines compilation of that package's src files.
renderOrderTable calls escapeHtml for order.id, customerId, and sku; html.ts supplies the escaping behavior for these HTML insertions.
renderPage uses escapeHtml to insert its title safely into the HTML title element.
apps/admin/src/index.ts exports order-dashboard and its supporting renderer modules as the new admin package surface.
renderOrderTable passes order.totalCents to formatMoney, whose cents-to-USD conversion determines displayed totals.
renderSummaryCards passes paidRevenueCents to the same formatMoney helper used for monetary display.
OrderDashboard.render passes its OrderFilters to renderOrderFilters so the form reflects the filters used for the displayed orders.
OrderDashboard.render sends the results of queries.list to renderOrderTable, including its empty-result behavior.
OrderDashboard.render composes its markup through renderPage, which supplies the document shell and stylesheet link.
OrderDashboard.render feeds summarizeOrders(orders) into renderSummaryCards to display metrics for the same filtered result set.

OrderDashboard composes admin HTML using a query service; OrderQueryService owns tenant filtering, predicates, sorting, and projection. UI composition and checkout query behavior are separate responsibilities across the list interface.

OrderDashboard invokes summarizeOrders while composing its page; packages/checkout/src/order-summary.ts independently defines order counts and paid revenue. Consuming that function does not merge presentation and domain aggregation review.

renderOrderFilters produces form controls and selected values; OrderQueryService applies tenant, state, and minimum-total filtering. Their shared OrderFilters contract connects distinct presentation and query responsibilities.
renderOrderTable formats and escapes OrderListItem values into HTML; toOrderListItem projects domain orders into that data contract. Rendering and domain projection can be reviewed separately.

renderSummaryCards displays an OrderSummary and formats its revenue; summarizeOrders computes the counts and paid revenue. Display and aggregation are separate responsibilities joined by a typed result.
The root tsconfig.json adds the apps/admin project reference, whose project configuration is supplied by apps/admin/tsconfig.json.
apps/admin/tsconfig.json includes src/**/*.ts and builds the new src/index.ts barrel and the renderer modules it exports.
checkout-service.ts supplies placedAt: this.clock.now() for the newly required Order.placedAt field in order.ts.
packages/checkout/src/index.ts exports order-query, exposing OrderQueryService and OrderFilters as part of the checkout package API.
packages/checkout/src/index.ts exports order-summary, exposing summarizeOrders and OrderSummary as part of the checkout package API.
OrderQueryService.list maps orders through toOrderListItem and declares OrderListItem[] as its result.
OrderQueryService.list calls the newly added OrderRepository.forTenant to restrict results before filtering, sorting, and projection.
toOrderListItem reads order.placedAt, which is introduced on Order by the order.ts hunk.
system.ts imports the new OrderQueryService implemented in order-query.ts for its query-service wiring.

data/migrations/001_orders.sql defines the orders schema, constraints, and index; data/seed.sql supplies two example order records. Schema design and fixture content are separate review responsibilities despite the inserts requiring that schema.

Both hunks change CheckoutService.place's order lifecycle: replay returns an existing result before a new attempt, while new orders receive placedAt for the checkout read model. Review the complete domain checkout behavior together.

packages/checkout/src/index.ts exposes retry requests, attempt tracking, and order reads as the checkout package API; system.ts assembles checkout and orderQueries over the shared orders repository. These exports belong to that domain integration review.
The idempotency and order-query exports expose the write/replay and read sides of the checkout domain assembled in system.ts. Review their public surface with the integrated checkout implementation.
system.ts uses the new repository imports and OrderQueryService import in the same system assembly, injecting retry state into CheckoutService and exposing orderQueries over its orders repository.
CheckoutHandler extracts an idempotency key for checkout writes; OrderDashboard renders existing orders and does not use that header or replay state.
RetryCheckoutWorker forwards retryable checkout writes, while OrderQueryService filters and projects existing orders without worker integration.
001_orders.sql defines order constraints and a tenant/date index; 002_idempotency_records.sql defines an independent tenant/key result table with no cross-table references.
The idempotency_records SQL schema governs stored retry results; apps/admin/admin.css governs dashboard presentation and has no dependency on that table.
README.md's single added hunk documents retry conflicts alongside the admin dashboard and SQL; it cannot be assigned wholly to checkout domain review from this evidence.
README.md's single added hunk describes OrderDashboard behavior together with checkout and SQL concerns, leaving its whole-unit grouping ambiguous.
README.md mentions persisted order constraints in the same hunk as retries and the dashboard; no separate documentation unit isolates the orders migration.
system.ts updates new CheckoutService(...) to pass idempotency and attempts, matching the two newly required constructor parameters in checkout-service.ts.
system.ts constructs orderQueries with new OrderQueryService(orders), requiring the OrderQueryService import added in hunk 1 as part of the same system wiring.
002_idempotency_records.sql and IdempotencyRepository both describe tenant/key result storage, but the repository uses a Map and no SQL adapter or migration integration is supplied.
The orders tenant/placed_at index resembles OrderQueryService's tenant filtering and descending placedAt sort, but the snippets show no SQL-backed query integration.

notes: Only the attached frozen case was used. Source text and comments were treated as evidence, not instructions; no other files, folders, splitter outputs, annotations, or internet sources were consulted.
